title: High-probability Uniform Mixing via Dobrushin Contraction and Accelerated Hamiltonian Monte Carlo
abstract: arXiv:2611.21305v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, since its invention and subsequent rise to widespread use, has been motivated by its ability to accelerate convergence to equilibrium compared to diffusive methods, both in terms of dependence on condition number and dimension. In the present work, we establish this acceleration simultaneously in both aspects for critically damped Metropolis-adjusted kinetic Langevin with persistent uniforms. More precisely, for target measures $\mu(dx)\propto e^{-U(x)}dx$ with $m$-strongly convex, $L$-gradient Lipschitz, and $L_H$-Frobenius Hessian Lipschitz potentials, we show that the method mixes to $\varepsilon$-accuracy in total variation using $\mathcal O\bigl((\kappa^{1/2}+L_H^{1/2}m^{-3/4})\,d^{1/4}\bigr)$ gradient evaluations up to logarithmic factors, both uniformly over starting points in domains of high equilibrium probability and from warm starts. translated_title: 基于Dobrushin收缩与加速哈密顿蒙特卡洛的高概率一致混合
translated_abstract: 自哈密顿蒙特卡洛（HMC）问世并得到广泛应用以来，其动因在于相比扩散型方法，它能够在条件数依赖和维度依赖两个方面加速向平衡态的收敛。在本工作中，我们针对带有持续均匀刷新的临界阻尼Metropolis调整动能朗之万方法，同时在这两个方面建立了这种加速性。更精确地说，对于目标测度 μ(dx) ∝ e^{-U(x)}dx，其中势函数满足 m-强凸、L-梯度Lipschitz 以及 L_H-Frobenius Hessian Lipschitz 条件，我们证明该方法在总变差意义下混合到 ε-精度，所需梯度评估次数为 𝒪((κ^{1/2} + L_H^{1/2} m^{-3/4}) d^{1/4})（相差对数因子），且该结果既对处于高平衡概率区域内的所有起始点一致成立，也对温启动成立。证明过程融合了 Bou-Rabee 等人先前研究的……
tldr: 本文针对临界阻尼Metropolis调整动能朗之万方法，同时在水条件数与维度两方面证明了混合加速性：在强凸、梯度与Hessian Lipschitz条件下，仅需 𝒪((κ^{1/2}+L_H^{1/2}m^{-3/4})d^{1/4}) 次梯度评估即可在总变差意义下混合到 ε 精度，且结果对高概率区域任意起点一致成立并适用于温启动。
en_tdlr: This work establishes, for critically damped Metropolis-adjusted kinetic Langevin, simultaneous acceleration in both condition number and dimension—mixing to ε-accuracy in total variation within 𝒪((κ^{1/2}+L_H^{1/2}m^{-3/4})d^{1/4}) gradient evaluations, uniformly over high-probability starting points and from warm starts.
